title: Choose your visual world
question: Three directions — serious impact, light grounds, no fluorescent. Pick one, steer it, or re-roll.

options.label: Studio Dumbar
options.thesis: Saturated print-ink color blocks layered over photography on a cool white ground. The visual language of the best brand studios.
options.viewport: Saturated color bar overlays a cropped photo. CHRIS MA in a neutral grotesque at large scale. Work grid as a photo-plus-bar module that tiles edge to edge.
options.risk: Reads generic if the photography is stock — distinctive when the composition is authored and the bars are structural, not decorative.

options.label: Swiss Offset Poster
options.thesis: Pure white ground, one deeply committed ink accent in your chosen color, Bebas at maximum scale. Zero decoration — authority through graphic weight alone.
options.viewport: CHRIS MA at near-full-viewport scale in black. A single full-width color rule below it. Work cases in a strict two-column grid with number and title.
options.risk: Timid spacing collapses it into every other minimal portfolio — the execution must be as committed as the concept.
options.case: Wins on product clarity: the graphic weight signals serious craft without needing to say it.

options.label: Luxury Book Cloth
options.lineage: Taschen, Penguin Modern Classics, Phaidon monographs
options.thesis: Rich non-neutral ground — deep slate, forest green, or burgundy — gold or parchment lettering. A physical object that happens to be a website.
options.viewport: Full-bleed rich-colored ground. Oversized name in a gold-toned weight. Work presented as a typeset table of contents with chapter numbers.
options.risk: Mis-executed it reads costume; well-executed it reads confident. Highest memorability of the three — lowest risk of looking AI-generated.
options.case: Most distinctive for a culturally-literate audience. No other portfolio in this category looks like this.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: Clean, professional portfolio — familiar arrangement, executed at full craft.
canonCard.viewport: Light ground, large name, work grid, about, contact. The arrangement a visitor expects, done well.
